items.docs: Retrieves the list of available pricing options for wallet top-ups, including custom amounts and standard pricing tiers

Updates the organization/business name for the current user's Stripe customer account

info.name: Create a Stripe SetupIntent for adding a payment method

items.docs: Creates a Stripe SetupIntent that allows users to securely add payment methods to their account. The SetupIntent provides a client secret that can be used with Stripe's frontend SDKs to collect payment method details.

info.name: Get the default payment method for the current user

items.docs: Retrieves the default payment method associated with the current user's account, including card details, validation status, and billing information.

info.name: Marks a payment method as the default.

items.docs: Marks a payment method as the default.

info.name: Get all payment methods for the current user

items.docs: Retrieves all saved payment methods associated with the current user's account, including card details, validation status, and billing information.
Permanently removes a saved payment method from the user's account. This action cannot be undone.

info.name: Validates a payment method after 3D Secure authentication

items.docs: Completes the validation process for a payment method that required 3D Secure authentication. This endpoint should be called after the user completes the 3D Secure challenge.

info.name: Confirm a payment using a saved payment method

items.docs: Processes a payment using a previously saved payment method. This endpoint handles wallet top-ups and may require 3D Secure authentication for certain payment methods or amounts.
